note: DRAFT MATERIAL, NEVER WIRED INTO THE GAME. This is what round two builds. School's correction: the job says the valley going quiet is the defect, and that is not established. Real quiet has a FLOOR near 30 dBA, a dead city measured only 5 to 7 dB below a live one in 2020, and constant ambience is a documented failure with a 30-40 minute fatigue clock inside a 100 hour game. So the fix is not 'fill the silence', it is three separate questions with three separate fixes.
